topicName: What are PL/SQL cursors and why are they used?
content: [{"order":1,"type":"heading","text":"What are PL/SQL cursors and why are they used?"},{"order":2,"type":"paragraph","text":"PL/SQL cursors are a mechanism to fetch and process data row by row from a result set returned by a SQL query. They are essential for handling queries that return multiple rows, allowing developers to manipulate data in a procedural manner."}]
